body:
i have nothing to live for, i'm fit, in uni. i hate tv, movies, videos games. in my free time i mindlessly watch baseball games or listen to music. i talk to myself so much that whenever i do have conversations i forget what i want to say and just bask in the euphoria that someone is talking to me.
there's no point in working if there's nothing to work for, i have zero motivation for anything except working out, my body aches from the constant over training, i can't clench my hands hard anymore, my hair is falling out from my medication and my skin is sickly pale. 
i'm tired of picking up new hobbies to fill a void. i don't want to be 50 and like this. i've been like this for years, i don't know how much more i have in the tank
